## QUICKBOOKS_GET_PROFIT_AND_LOSS_REPORT
Generate a Profit and Loss report showing company income and expenses over a period. Use when you need to analyze profitability, revenue, costs, and net income for a specific date range.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetProfitAndLossReportRequest",
  "properties": {
    "end_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date",
      "description": "Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, defaults to today's date."
    },
    "class_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Class Ids",
      "description": "List of class IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all classes. Each ID should be the Class.Id value from the Class object (e.g., ['1', '3'])."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order."
    },
    "start_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date",
      "description": "Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, defaults to the start of the current fiscal year."
    },
    "vendor_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Vendor Ids",
      "description": "List of vendor IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all vendors. Each ID should be the Vendor.Id value from the Vendor object (e.g., ['1', '5', '20'])."
    },
    "report_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Date",
      "description": "Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "customer_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Customer Ids",
      "description": "List of customer IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all customers. Each ID should be the Customer.Id value from the Customer object (e.g., ['1', '2', '10'])."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. "
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report. "
    },
    "summarize_column_by": {
      "enum": [
        "Total",
        "Month",
        "Week",
        "Days",
        "Quarter",
        "Year",
        "Customers",
        "Vendors",
        "Classes",
        "Departments",
        "Employees",
        "ProductsAndServices"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SummarizeColumnBy",
      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a Profit and Loss report."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_PURCHASE
Tool to fetch details of a specific purchase by ID in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to retrieve complete purchase information including line items, payment details, and metadata.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPurchaseRequest",
  "required": [
    "purchase_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "purchase_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Purchase Id",
      "examples": [
        "20"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the purchase to retrieve"
    },
    "minorversion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Minorversion",
      "examples": [
        65,
        75
      ],
      "description": "API minor version to use for the request. If not provided, uses the version from metadata headers."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for getting a purchase by ID."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_PURCHASE_ORDER
Tool to fetch a QuickBooks purchase order by ID. Use when needing full purchase order details including line items, vendor information, and metadata.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",

    "purchase_order_id"

      "title": "Purchase Order Id",

}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_PURCHASE_ORDER_PDF
Tool to download a QuickBooks purchase order as a PDF file. Use when you need to retrieve the printable PDF version of a purchase order.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPurchaseOrderPdfRequest",
  "required": [
    "purchase_order_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "minorversion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Minorversion",
      "examples": [
        "70",
        "75"
      ],
      "description": "API minor version to use for the request (e.g., '70', '75'). If not specified, uses the default API version."
    },
    "purchase_order_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Purchase Order Id",
      "examples": [
        "25",
        "123"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the purchase order to retrieve as PDF (e.g., '25', '123')."

  },
  "description": "Request parameters to download a purchase order as PDF."
}
```

```json
          "description": "Email status of the refund receipt. Valid values: NotSet, NeedToSend, EmailSent."
        },

          "type": "number",
          "title": "Home Balance",

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Print Status",

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Private Note",
          "description": "User-entered private note about the transaction, not visible to the customer. Maximum 4000 characters."
        },
        "CheckPayment": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Check Payment",
          "description": "Check payment details if payment method is check.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },

          "title": "Customer Memo",
          "properties": {
            "value": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Value",

            }
          },
          "description": "User-entered message to the customer that appears on the refund receipt."
        },
        "ExchangeRate": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Exchange Rate",
          "description": "The exchange rate for the transaction. Applicable if multi-currency is enabled. Defaults to 1."
        },
        "HomeTotalAmt": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Home Total Amt",
          "description": "The total amount expressed in the home currency. Applicable if multi-currency is enabled. Read-only."
        },

                      },

                        "type": "number",
                        "title": "Net Amount Taxable",

                      }
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REFUND_RECEIPT_PDF
Tool to download a QuickBooks refund receipt as a PDF file. Use when you need to retrieve the printable PDF version of a refund receipt.

```json
        "75"
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_ACCOUNT_LIST
Retrieve the AccountList report from QuickBooks showing a list of all accounts. This report displays all account details including name, type, and balance information.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportAccountListRequest",
  "properties": {
    "columns": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Columns",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of column names to include in the report. Valid column names: 'account_name', 'account_type', 'detail_acc_type', 'account_desc', 'account_bal'. If not specified, all columns are included. Example: 'account_name,account_type,account_bal'"
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort Order",
      "description": "The sort order for the accounts. Valid values: 'ascend' (ascending, A-Z) or 'descend' (descending, Z-A). If not specified, accounts are returned in their default order."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for AccountList report."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_AGED_PAYABLE_DETAIL
Generate an aged payable detail report showing aging detail for accounts payable. Use when you need to analyze outstanding vendor bills grouped by aging periods.

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_AGED_PAYABLES
Retrieve an Aged Payables aging summary report from QuickBooks showing outstanding vendor balances grouped by age. Shows amounts owed to vendors categorized by aging periods (e.g., current, 1-30 days, 31-60 days overdue).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportAgedPayablesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "appaid": {
      "enum": [
        "All",
        "Paid",
        "Unpaid"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Arpaid",
      "description": "Filters vendors by payment status. Use 'All' for all vendors, 'Paid' for vendors with fully paid balances, or 'Unpaid' for vendors with outstanding balances. Default is 'Unpaid'."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Date Macro",
      "description": "Predefined date macro like 'Today', 'This Month', etc. Alternative to report_date for specifying the report date using a macro."
    },
    "vendor_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Vendor Ids",
      "description": "Filters report contents to include information for specified vendors. Provide one or more comma-separated vendor IDs as returned in the Vendor.Id attribute."
    },
    "num_periods": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Num Periods",
      "maximum": 10,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of aging periods to display in the report. Must be between 1 and 10. Defaults to 4 if not specified. Each period shows payables within that age range."
    },
    "report_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Date",
      "description": "Date for the aged payables report in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today if not provided. This is the as-of date for calculating aging."
    },
    "aging_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Report_Date",
        "Current"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AgingMethod",
      "description": "Method for calculating aging. 'Report_Date' calculates aging from the report date, 'Current' calculates aging from the current date. Defaults to 'Report_Date' if not specified."
    },
    "aging_period": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Aging Period",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of days per aging period. Must be at least 1. Defaults to 30 days if not specified. For example, with 30 days you get periods like 0-30, 31-60, etc."
    },
    "minorversion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Minorversion",
      "description": "API minor version number. Optional - defaults to x-minor-version header if not provided. Use this to access features from specific minor versions of the QuickBooks API."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for AgedPayables report."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_AGED_RECEIVABLE_DETAIL
Generate an aged receivable detail report showing aging detail for accounts receivable. Use when you need to analyze outstanding customer invoices grouped by aging periods.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportAgedReceivableDetailRequest",

Additional columns with custom fields enabled: sales_cust1, sales_cust2, sales_cust3. Additional columns with location tracking enabled: dept_name*"
    },

      "description": "Number of days per aging period. Default is typically 30 days. For example, setting this to 30 creates buckets like 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 days."
    },

      "items": {

      },
      "title": "Customer Ids",

    },

        "Next Week",

        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range of due dates for receivables to include in the report; otherwise, use the start_duedate and end_duedate to cover an explicit report date range. "
    },
    "start_duedate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Duedate",
      "description": "The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",

    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report."
    }
  }
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_CASH_FLOW
Generate a cash flow report in QuickBooks showing cash inflows and outflows categorized by operating, investing, and financing activities. Use when you need to analyze cash movement and liquidity over a specified period.

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_CLASS_SALES
Generate a ClassSales report in QuickBooks showing sales amounts grouped by class. Use when you need to analyze sales performance by class tracking categories.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportClassSalesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "class_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Class Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated class IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all classes. Each ID should be the Class.Id value from the Class object."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order."
    },
    "report_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Date",
      "description": "Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. "
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report. "
    },
    "summarize_column_by": {
      "enum": [
        "Total",
        "Month",
        "Week",
        "Days",
        "Quarter",
        "Year",
        "Customers",
        "Vendors",
        "Classes",
        "Departments",
        "Employees",
        "ProductsAndServices"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SummarizeColumnBy",
      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for ClassSales report."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_CUSTOMER_INCOME
Generate a customer income report in QuickBooks showing revenue by customer. Use when you need to analyze income generated from each customer over a specified period.

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_CUSTOMER_SALES
Generate a customer sales report in QuickBooks showing sales transactions and totals for customers. Can filter by specific customers, date ranges, and accounting method. Returns a hierarchical report with customer names, IDs, and their sales amounts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportCustomerSalesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "end_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date",
      "description": "Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use together with start_date to specify a custom date range."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order."
    },
    "start_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date",
      "description": "Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use together with end_date to specify a custom date range."
    },
    "report_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Date",
      "description": "Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "customer_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Customer Ids",
      "description": "List of customer IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all customers. Each ID should be the Customer.Id value from the Customer object (e.g., ['1', '2', '10'])."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. "
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report. "
    },
    "summarize_column_by": {
      "enum": [
        "Total",
        "Month",
        "Week",
        "Days",
        "Quarter",
        "Year",
        "Customers",
        "Vendors",
        "Classes",
        "Departments",
        "Employees",
        "ProductsAndServices"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SummarizeColumnBy",
      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for CustomerSales report."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_DEPARTMENT_SALES
Generate a department sales report in QuickBooks showing sales data broken down by department. Use when you need to analyze sales performance across different departments within a date range. Note: Department tracking must be enabled in the QuickBooks company file for this report to return data.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportDepartmentSalesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "end_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date",
      "description": "End date for the report period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use this with start_date to specify a custom date range, or use date_macro for predefined ranges."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range for the report (e.g., 'This Month', 'Last Quarter'). Use this as an alternative to specifying start_date and end_date explicitly."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order for the report results (ascend or descend)."
    },
    "start_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date",
      "description": "Start date for the report period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use this with end_date to specify a custom date range, or use date_macro for predefined ranges."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "List of department IDs to filter the report. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if configured in the company file."
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report (Cash or Accrual)."
    },
    "summarize_column_by": {
      "enum": [
        "Total",
        "Month",
        "Week",
        "Days",
        "Quarter",
        "Year",
        "Customers",
        "Vendors",
        "Classes",
        "Departments",
        "Employees",
        "ProductsAndServices"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SummarizeColumnBy",
      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results (e.g., Total, Month, Quarter)."
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_ITEM_SALES
Generate an ItemSales report showing sales data for products and services. Use when you need to analyze sales performance by item including quantity sold, revenue, COGS, and gross margin.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportItemSalesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "item_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Item Ids",
      "description": "List of item IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all items. Each ID should be the Item.Id value from the Item object (e.g., ['1', '2', '10'])."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order."
    },
    "report_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Date",
      "description": "Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. "
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report. "
    },
    "summarize_column_by": {
      "enum": [
        "Total",
        "Month",
        "Week",
        "Days",
        "Quarter",
        "Year",
        "Customers",
        "Vendors",
        "Classes",
        "Departments",
        "Employees",
        "ProductsAndServices"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SummarizeColumnBy",
      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for ItemSales report."
}
```

```json
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORTS
Retrieve QuickBooks reports such as TransactionList, BalanceSheet, ProfitAndLoss, and others. Use when you need to access standardized financial or transaction reports with flexible filtering options.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportsRequest",
  "required": [
    "report_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "vendor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Vendor",
      "examples": [
        "5",
        "5,8,12"
      ],
      "description": "Vendor ID or comma-separated list of vendor IDs to filter the report. Only transactions related to these vendors will be included. Use Vendor.Id value from the Vendor object."
    },
    "cleared": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cleared",
      "examples": [
        "All",
        "Cleared",
        "Uncleared",
        "Reconciled"
      ],
      "description": "Filter for transaction cleared status. Options: 'All', 'Cleared', 'Uncleared', 'Reconciled'. Note that 'cleared' can only be used as a filter parameter, not as a column in the result."
    },
    "columns": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Columns",
      "examples": [
        "tx_date,txn_type,amount",
        "doc_num,name,memo,account"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of column types to include in the report. For example: 'tx_date,txn_type,doc_num,name,memo,account,amount'. If not specified, the report uses default columns."
    },
    "sort_by": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort By",
      "examples": [
        "tx_date",
        "txn_type",
        "amount"
      ],
      "description": "Column type to use for sorting report rows. Common values include 'tx_date', 'txn_type', 'amount', etc. Must be a column that exists in the report."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "1",
        "1,2,10"
      ],
      "description": "Customer ID or comma-separated list of customer IDs to filter the report. Only transactions related to these customers will be included. Use Customer.Id value from the Customer object."
    },
    "end_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date",
      "examples": [
        "2024-12-31",
        "2024-06-30"
      ],
      "description": "Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to filter transactions or data up to this date. If not provided, the report uses its default end date or date_macro setting."
    },
    "group_by": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group By",
      "examples": [
        "Customer",
        "Vendor",
        "Account"
      ],
      "description": "Column type to use for grouping report rows. Common values include 'Customer', 'Vendor', 'Account', etc. Groups transactions by the specified entity type."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order."
    },
    "start_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-01",
        "2024-06-01"
      ],
      "description": "Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to filter transactions or data from this date onwards. If not provided, the report uses its default start date or date_macro setting."
    },
    "report_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Date",
      "description": "Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "report_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Name",
      "examples": [
        "TransactionList",
        "BalanceSheet",
        "ProfitAndLoss"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the report to retrieve. For example: 'TransactionList', 'BalanceSheet', 'ProfitAndLoss', 'CashFlow', etc. This is the report type identifier used in the QuickBooks API endpoint."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. "
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report. "
    },
    "summarize_column_by": {
      "enum": [
        "Total",
        "Month",
        "Week",
        "Days",
        "Quarter",
        "Year",
        "Customers",
        "Vendors",
        "Classes",
        "Departments",
        "Employees",
        "ProductsAndServices"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SummarizeColumnBy",
      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a TransactionList report."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_TRIAL_BALANCE
Generate a Trial Balance report showing account debits, credits, and balances for a specified period. Use when you need to verify that total debits equal total credits across all accounts for accounting reconciliation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",

  "properties": {
    "end_date": {

        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",

        "descend"
      ],

    },

      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. "

      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a Trial Balance report."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_SALES_RECEIPT
Tool to fetch a QuickBooks sales receipt by ID. Use when needing full sales receipt details including customer info, line items, payment details, and metadata.

**Input schema:**

```json
      "title": "Sales Receipt Id",

      "description": "ID of the sales receipt to read from QuickBooks"

}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_SALESRECEIPT_PDF
Tool to download a QuickBooks sales receipt as a PDF file. Use when you need to retrieve the printable PDF version of a sales receipt.

```json
  "required": [
    "sales_receipt_id"

      "examples": [
        "70",
        "75"
      ],
      "description": "API minor version to use for the request (e.g., '70', '75'). If not specified, uses the default API version."

      "examples": [
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_TRANSACTION_LIST_REPORT
Get the Transaction List report showing all transactions in the company. Use when you need a comprehensive view of all transactions with flexible filtering by date, customer, vendor, account, or other criteria.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTransactionListReportRequest",
  "properties": {
    "cleared": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cleared",
      "examples": [
        "All",
        "Cleared",
        "Uncleared",
        "Reconciled"
      ],
      "description": "Filter for transaction cleared status. Options: 'All', 'Cleared', 'Uncleared', 'Reconciled'. Note that 'cleared' can only be used as a filter parameter, not as a column in the result."
    },
    "columns": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Columns",
      "examples": [
        "date,transaction_type,number,name,memo,account,amount",
        "tx_date,txn_type,doc_num,name,memo,account_name,subt_nat_amount",
        "date,account,amount"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of columns to include in the report. Supports both user-friendly names and QuickBooks API identifiers: date/tx_date (Date), transaction_type/txn_type (Transaction Type), number/num/doc_num (Number), name (Name), memo/description (Memo/Description), account/account_name (Account), amount/subt_nat_amount (Amount), net_amount (Net Amount), split (Split), balance (Balance), customer (Customer), vendor (Vendor), employee (Employee), product_service (Product/Service), quantity (Quantity), rate (Rate), class (Class), department/dept (Department), location (Location). If not specified, report uses default columns."
    },
    "sort_by": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort By",
      "examples": [
        "date",
        "amount",
        "tx_date",
        "subt_nat_amount"
      ],
      "description": "Column to sort report rows by. Supports both user-friendly names (date, transaction_type, amount, account, etc.) and QuickBooks API identifiers (tx_date, txn_type, subt_nat_amount, account_name, etc.). Must be a column that exists in the report."
    },
    "end_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date",
      "examples": [
        "2024-12-31",
        "2024-06-30"
      ],
      "description": "Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to filter transactions up to this date. If not provided, the report uses its default end date or date_macro setting."
    },
    "group_by": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group By",
      "examples": [
        "Customer",
        "Vendor",
        "Account"
      ],
      "description": "Column type to use for grouping report rows. Common values include 'Customer', 'Vendor', 'Account', etc. Groups transactions by the specified entity type."
    },
    "class_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Class Ids",
      "description": "List of class IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all classes. Each ID should be the Class.Id value (e.g., ['1', '2'])."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range for the report. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order for rows (ascending or descending). Default is ascending."
    },
    "start_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-01",
        "2024-06-01"
      ],
      "description": "Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to filter transactions from this date onwards. If not provided, the report uses its default start date or date_macro setting."
    },
    "vendor_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Vendor Ids",
      "description": "List of vendor IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all vendors. Each ID should be the Vendor.Id value from the Vendor object (e.g., ['5', '8', '12'])."
    },
    "account_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Account Ids",
      "description": "List of account IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all accounts. Each ID should be the Account.Id value from the Account object (e.g., ['1', '35', '82'])."
    },
    "customer_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Customer Ids",
      "description": "List of customer IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all customers. Each ID should be the Customer.Id value from the Customer object (e.g., ['1', '2', '10'])."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "List of department IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all departments. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file."
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report (Cash or Accrual)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a Transaction List report."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_TRANSFER
Tool to fetch a QuickBooks transfer by ID. Use when needing to retrieve transfer details including from/to account references and transfer amount.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTransferRequest",
  "required": [
    "transfer_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "transfer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Transfer Id",
      "examples": [
        "1",
        "123"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the transfer to retrieve from QuickBooks"
    },
    "minorversion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Minorversion",
      "examples": [
        65
      ],
      "description": "API minor version to use for the request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default from headers."
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_VENDOR_CREDIT
Tool to fetch a QuickBooks vendor credit by ID. Use when needing to retrieve vendor credit details including vendor reference, line items, amounts, and balance status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetVendorCreditRequest",
  "required": [
    "vendor_credit_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "minorversion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Minorversion",
      "examples": [
        65
      ],
      "description": "API minor version to use for the request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default from headers."
    },
    "vendor_credit_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Vendor Credit Id",
      "examples": [
        "27",
        "185"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the vendor credit to retrieve from QuickBooks"
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_GET_VENDOR_EXPENSES_REPORT
Retrieve a vendor expenses report from QuickBooks showing expense transactions by vendor. This report displays the total expenses incurred for each vendor, providing a detailed view of vendor-related spending. Filter by specific vendors, date ranges, payment status, and customize with various grouping and sorting options.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetVendorExpensesReportRequest",
  "properties": {
    "qzurl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Qzurl",
      "description": "Specifies whether Quick Zoom URL information should be generated for rows in the report."
    },
    "appaid": {
      "enum": [
        "All",
        "Paid",
        "Unpaid"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Arpaid",
      "description": "Filters vendors by payment status. Use 'All' for all vendors, 'Paid' for vendors with fully paid balances, or 'Unpaid' for vendors with outstanding balances."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order."
    },
    "vendor_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Vendor Ids",
      "description": "Filters report contents to include information for specified vendors. Supported Values: One or more comma separated vendor IDs as returned in the attribute, Vendor.Id, of the Vendor object response code."
    },
    "report_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Date",
      "description": "Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. "
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report. "
    },
    "summarize_column_by": {
      "enum": [
        "Total",
        "Month",
        "Week",
        "Days",
        "Quarter",
        "Year",
        "Customers",
        "Vendors",
        "Classes",
        "Departments",
        "Employees",
        "ProductsAndServices"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SummarizeColumnBy",
      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results."
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_LIST_CARDS
Tool to retrieve all payment cards on file for a customer in QuickBooks Payments API. Use when needing to list saved payment methods for a customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListCardsRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "customer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Id",
      "examples": [
        "00205184c555f1660c42d19c2d324f86ac3567"
      ],
      "description": "The QuickBooks Payments V4IDPseudonym identifier for the customer. This is different from the QuickBooks Online customer ID - use the V4IDPseudonym field from the customer object."
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_LIST_DEPARTMENTS
Query Department entities in QuickBooks using SQL-like syntax. Use when you need to list departments or filter departments by criteria like active status, name patterns, or parent relationships. Supports WHERE clauses, pattern matching (LIKE with %), ORDERBY, and pagination.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListDepartmentsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "SELECT * FROM Department",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT * FROM Department",
        "SELECT * FROM Department WHERE Active = true MAXRESULTS 100",
        "SELECT * FROM Department WHERE SubDepartment = false ORDERBY Name",
        "SELECT * FROM Department WHERE Name LIKE '%Sales%' MAXRESULTS 10",
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Department WHERE Active = true"
      ],
      "description": "SQL-like query string to filter and retrieve Department entities ONLY. IMPORTANT: This tool queries the Department entity exclusively - do NOT use it to query other entities. For querying other entity types, use their respective query tools. \n\nQuery syntax: SELECT [fields] FROM Department [WHERE conditions] [ORDERBY field] [STARTPOSITION n] [MAXRESULTS n] \n\nNOTE: QuickBooks API returns ALL fields with values regardless of SELECT clause - field projections are not supported. You can write 'SELECT Id, Name' but the API will return all available fields anyway. \n\nCommonly queryable Department fields: Id, Name, Active, FullyQualifiedName, SubDepartment, ParentRef, SyncToken. \n\nSupports: - WHERE clauses with operators (=, <, >, <=, >=, IN) - LIKE operator with % wildcard - Boolean operators (AND, OR) - ORDERBY for sorting - Pagination with MAXRESULTS (max 1000, default 100) and STARTPOSITION - Aggregate functions (COUNT)"
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_QUERY_ACCOUNT
Query Account entities in QuickBooks using SQL-like syntax. IMPORTANT: Queries the Account entity ONLY (chart of accounts). For other entities (Purchase, Invoice, Bill, Payment, etc.), use their respective query actions. NOTE: API returns ALL fields with values regardless of SELECT clause (projections not supported). Supports: WHERE clauses (=, <, >, LIKE, IN), pattern matching (%), ORDER BY, pagination (MAXRESULTS up to 1000, STARTPOSITION), COUNT. Common fields: Id, Name, AccountType, AccountSubType, Classification, Active, FullyQualifiedName, CurrentBalance, AcctNum, Description, SubAccount. Examples: - SELECT * FROM Account WHERE AccountType = 'Expense' MAXRESULTS 100 - SELECT * FROM Account WHERE Active = true ORDER BY Name - SELECT * FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '%Checking%'

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "QueryAccountRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT * FROM Account",
        "SELECT * FROM Account WHERE AccountType = 'Expense' MAXRESULTS 100",
        "SELECT * FROM Account WHERE Active = true ORDER BY Name",
        "SELECT * FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '%Checking%' MAXRESULTS 10",
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Account WHERE Classification = 'Asset'",
        "SELECT * FROM Account ORDER BY Id STARTPOSITION 1 MAXRESULTS 100"
      ],
      "description": "SQL-like query string to filter and retrieve Account entities ONLY. IMPORTANT: This tool queries the Account entity exclusively - do NOT use it to query other entities like Purchase, Invoice, Bill, Payment, etc. For querying other entity types, use their respective query tools. \n\nQuery syntax: SELECT [fields] FROM Account [WHERE conditions] [ORDER BY field] [STARTPOSITION n] [MAXRESULTS n] \n\nNOTE: QuickBooks API returns ALL fields with values regardless of SELECT clause - field projections are not supported. You can write 'SELECT Id, Name' but the API will return all available fields anyway. \n\nCommonly queryable Account fields: Id, Name, AccountType, AccountSubType, Classification, Active, FullyQualifiedName, CurrentBalance, AcctNum, Description, SubAccount. \n\nSupports: - WHERE clauses with operators (=, <, >, <=, >=, IN) - LIKE operator with % wildcard - Boolean operators (AND, OR) - ORDER BY for sorting (MUST be two words, not 'ORDERBY'). Sortable fields: Name, Id. Non-sortable fields include AccountType, AccountSubType, Classification, and others. - Pagination with MAXRESULTS (max 1000, default 100) and STARTPOSITION - Aggregate functions (COUNT)"
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_QUERY_ATTACHABLE
Query Attachable entities in QuickBooks using SQL-like syntax. Use when you need to retrieve multiple attachables or search for specific file attachments.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "QueryAttachableRequest",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "SELECT * FROM Attachable",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT * FROM Attachable",
        "SELECT * FROM Attachable WHERE Category = 'Receipt' MAXRESULTS 100",
        "SELECT * FROM Attachable WHERE FileName LIKE '%.pdf%' MAXRESULTS 10",
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Attachable"
      ],
      "description": "SQL-like query string to filter and retrieve Attachable entities ONLY. IMPORTANT: This tool queries the Attachable entity exclusively - do NOT use it to query other entities like Purchase, Invoice, Bill, Payment, etc. For querying other entity types, use their respective query tools. \n\nQuery syntax: SELECT [fields] FROM Attachable [WHERE conditions] [ORDERBY field] [STARTPOSITION n] [MAXRESULTS n] \n\nNOTE: QuickBooks API returns ALL fields with values regardless of SELECT clause - field projections are not supported. You can write 'SELECT Id, FileName' but the API will return all available fields anyway. \n\nCommonly queryable Attachable fields: Id, FileName, Note, Category, ContentType, Size, FileAccessUri, TempDownloadUri. \n\nSupports: - WHERE clauses with operators (=, <, >, <=, >=, IN) - LIKE operator with % wildcard - Boolean operators (AND, OR) - ORDERBY for sorting - Pagination with MAXRESULTS (max 1000, default 100) and STARTPOSITION - Aggregate functions (COUNT)"
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_QUERY_ENTITIES
Execute SQL-like queries on QuickBooks Online entities. Supports all entity types (Customer, Invoice, Bill, Payment, Purchase, Account, etc.) with WHERE clauses, pattern matching, ordering, and pagination. IMPORTANT: Many fields are NOT queryable in WHERE clauses including PrivateNote, AccountRef, CurrencyRef, DepartmentRef, ClassRef, etc. Use queryable fields like Id, TxnDate, PaymentType, DisplayName instead. For non-queryable field filtering, query by date range and filter client-side. See parameter description for full list of queryable vs non-queryable fields. Use entity-specific query tools when available for typed responses.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "QueryEntitiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT * FROM Customer MAXRESULTS 5",
        "SELECT * FROM Customer WHERE DisplayName LIKE '%Smith%' MAXRESULTS 10",
        "SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE TotalAmt > '100' ORDERBY TxnDate",
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bill WHERE DueDate < '2024-01-01'",
        "SELECT * FROM Payment WHERE TxnDate >= '2024-01-01' AND TxnDate <= '2024-12-31'",
        "SELECT * FROM Purchase WHERE TxnDate >= '2024-01-01' AND PaymentType = 'Check'"
      ],
      "description": "SQL-like query string to retrieve data from QuickBooks Online entities. This is a generic query tool that supports all QuickBooks entity types including Customer, Invoice, Bill, Payment, Purchase, Account, Vendor, Employee, Item, and more. \n\nQuery syntax: SELECT [fields] FROM [EntityName] [WHERE conditions] [ORDERBY field] [STARTPOSITION n] [MAXRESULTS n] \n\nNOTE: QuickBooks API returns ALL fields with values regardless of SELECT clause - field projections are not supported. You can write 'SELECT Id, Name' but the API will return all available fields anyway. \n\nSupported clauses and operators: - WHERE clauses with comparison operators (=, <, >, <=, >=, !=) - LIKE operator with % wildcard for pattern matching - IN operator for matching multiple values - Boolean operators (AND, OR) to combine conditions - ORDERBY for sorting results - Pagination with MAXRESULTS (max 1000, default 100) and STARTPOSITION - Aggregate functions (COUNT) \n\nCRITICAL QUERY FIELD RESTRICTIONS - READ CAREFULLY: \n\nQuickBooks API has strict rules about which fields can be queried. Many fields that appear in entity responses CANNOT be used in WHERE clauses: \n\n\u2713 QUERYABLE reference fields (you CAN use these in WHERE clauses):   - Top-level entity references on transactions: CustomerRef, VendorRef on Invoice/Bill/Payment/Purchase entities   - Example: 'SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE CustomerRef = \"123\"' \u2713 WORKS   - Example: 'SELECT * FROM Bill WHERE VendorRef = \"456\"' \u2713 WORKS \n\n\u2717 NON-QUERYABLE fields (you CANNOT use these in WHERE clauses):   - PrivateNote on Invoice, Purchase, and most other entity types (causes QueryValidationError)   - AccountRef, CurrencyRef, DepartmentRef, ClassRef on ANY entity   - ItemRef, CustomerRef, VendorRef on LINE ITEMS within transactions   - Any nested reference field (e.g., Line[].ItemRef, Line[].AccountRef)   - Example: 'SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE PrivateNote LIKE \"%text%\"' \u2717 FAILS with QueryValidationError   - Example: 'SELECT * FROM Purchase WHERE AccountRef = \"92\"' \u2717 FAILS with QueryValidationError   - Example: 'SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE CurrencyRef = \"USD\"' \u2717 FAILS \n\nWORKAROUND for non-queryable fields: Query by date range and filter client-side: 'SELECT * FROM Purchase WHERE TxnDate >= \"2024-01-01\"', then filter results by AccountRef or other non-queryable fields in your code. Alternatively, use entity-specific GET actions to retrieve by ID. \n\nVerified queryable fields for Purchase entity (the most commonly problematic): - Queryable: Id, TxnDate, PaymentType, DocNumber, TotalAmt, PrintStatus - NOT queryable: AccountRef, CurrencyRef, DepartmentRef, ClassRef, PrivateNote (causes QueryValidationError) \n\nCommon queryable fields for other entity types (examples only - not exhaustive): - Invoice: Id, TxnDate, DueDate, DocNumber, TotalAmt, Balance, CustomerRef, EmailStatus, PrintStatus (PrivateNote is NOT queryable) - Bill: Id, TxnDate, DueDate, DocNumber, TotalAmt, Balance, VendorRef - Payment: Id, TxnDate, DocNumber, TotalAmt, CustomerRef, PaymentType - Customer: Id, DisplayName, GivenName, FamilyName, CompanyName, PrimaryEmailAddr, Active, Balance - Vendor: Id, DisplayName, GivenName, FamilyName, CompanyName, PrimaryEmailAddr, Active, Balance - Account: Id, Name, AccountType, AccountSubType, Active - Item: Id, Name, Type, Active \n\nIMPORTANT: The above lists are common examples. To discover all queryable fields for an entity type, consult the official QuickBooks API documentation at https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries or test incrementally. Reference fields are generally NOT queryable unless explicitly documented. \n\nIMPORTANT: Use entity-specific query tools when available (e.g., QueryAccount for Account entities) as they provide typed responses. This generic tool returns untyped data and should be used only when no specific query tool exists for the entity type."
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_READ_EMPLOYEE
Read an employee's details in QuickBooks with the given employee ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadEmployeeRequest",

  "properties": {
    "employee_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Employee Id",
      "description": "The ID of the employee to be read."

}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_READ_INVOICE
Tool to fetch a QuickBooks invoice by ID or the most recent if no ID provided. Use when needing full invoice details including metadata and sync token.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadInvoiceRequest",
  "properties": {
    "invoice_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the invoice to read; if not provided, fetches the latest invoice"
    },
    "minorversion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Minorversion",
      "examples": [
        65
      ],
      "description": "API minor version to use for the request"
    }
  }
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_READ_VENDOR
Read a vendor in QuickBooks with the given vendor ID.

**Input schema:**

```json
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_SEND_CREDIT_MEMO
Tool to send a credit memo to a specified email address. Use when you need to email a credit memo to a customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SendCreditMemoRequest",
  "required": [
    "credit_memo_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "send_to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Send To",
      "examples": [
        "test@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Optional email address to send the credit memo to. If not provided, sends to the customer's default email."
    },
    "minorversion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Minorversion",
      "description": "QuickBooks API minor version number (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default version from headers."
    },
    "credit_memo_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Credit Memo Id",
      "examples": [
        "14"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the credit memo to send"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for sending a credit memo."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_UPDATE_ATTACHABLE
Tool to update an existing attachable in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to modify attachable properties like note text or entity references. Requires the attachable Id and current SyncToken for optimistic locking.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateAttachableRequest",
  "required": [
    "Id",
    "SyncToken"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "Id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "description": "The ID of the attachable to update."
    },
    "Lat": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lat",
      "description": "Latitude coordinate where the file was created."
    },
    "Tag": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tag",
      "description": "Tag string for the attachable."
    },
    "Long": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Long",
      "description": "Longitude coordinate where the file was created."
    },
    "Note": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Note",
      "description": "Note text for the attachable."
    },
    "Category": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Category",
      "description": "Category of the attachable (e.g., Image, Document, Sound, Receipt, Other, etc.)."
    },
    "PlaceName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Place Name",
      "description": "Name of the place where the file was created."
    },
    "SyncToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sync Token",
      "description": "The current SyncToken value for optimistic locking. Must match the latest value from QuickBooks."
    },
    "AttachableRef": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "AttachableRefItem",
        "properties": {
          "EntityRef": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "EntityRef",
            "properties": {
              "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Name",
                "description": "Name of the referenced entity."
              },
              "type": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Type",
                "description": "Type of the entity (e.g., Customer, Invoice, Bill, Vendor, Account, etc.)."
              },
              "value": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Value",
                "description": "ID of the referenced entity."
              }
            },
            "description": "Reference to an entity that the attachable is linked to.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "IncludeOnSend": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Include On Send",
            "description": "Whether to include this attachable when sending the entity."
          }
        },
        "description": "Reference item linking the attachable to an entity."
      },
      "title": "Attachable Ref",
      "description": "Array of references to entities this attachable is linked to."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to update an existing attachable in QuickBooks Online."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_UPDATE_DEPARTMENT
Tool to update an existing department in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to modify department details. Requires the department Id and current SyncToken to prevent concurrent update conflicts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateDepartmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "Id",
    "SyncToken",
    "Name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "Id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the department to update. Required for update operations."
    },
    "Name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "maxLength": 100,
      "description": "Updated name of the department. Maximum length is 100 characters."
    },
    "Active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "description": "Whether the department is active. Inactive departments may be hidden from most display purposes."
    },
    "sparse": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Sparse",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Set to true to perform a partial update (only specified fields are updated). Defaults to true for update operations."
    },
    "ParentRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Parent Ref",
      "description": "Reference to the parent department if this is a sub-department. Contains 'value' (ID) and optionally 'name'.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "SyncToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sync Token",
      "description": "Version token for optimistic locking, obtained from a prior GET request. Prevents concurrent update conflicts."
    },
    "SubDepartment": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Sub Department",
      "description": "Whether this department is a sub-department. If true, ParentRef should be provided."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a department in QuickBooks."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_UPDATE_FULL_INVOICE
Tool to fully replace an Invoice. Use when you need to update all aspects of an existing invoice in a single operation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFullInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "description": "Full Invoice JSON payload to update; must include Id and SyncToken. Any writable field omitted will be cleared. Do not set sparse=true.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "requestid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Requestid",
      "description": "Optional idempotency key (<=50 chars) to prevent duplicate writes on retries."
    },
    "minorversion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Minorversion",
      "description": "Optional QuickBooks API minorversion to access newer fields (e.g., 63)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for fully replacing an existing QuickBooks Invoice."
}
```

```json
  "title": "UpdateFullInvoiceResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",

  "properties": {
    "data": {

                      }
                    },

                        "description": "Account identifier."

              "SalesItemLineDetail": {

                      },

                    },

                  "ClassRef": {
                    "type": "object",

                      },
                      "value": {

                        "title": "Value",

                    },

                        "title": "Value",
                        "description": "Tax code identifier."
                      }
                    },

                  },
                  "ServiceDate": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Service Date",
                    "description": "Date when the service was performed or the product was delivered."
```

## QUICKBOOKS_UPDATE_PAYMENT_METHOD
Tool to update an existing payment method in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to modify the name, status, or type of a payment method. Requires the payment method Id and current SyncToken.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePaymentMethodRequest",
  "required": [
    "Id",
    "SyncToken",
    "Name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "Id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "2",
        "8"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the payment method to update. Required for updates."
    },
    "Name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Business Check-Updated",
        "Cash",
        "American Express"
      ],
      "maxLength": 31,
      "description": "User-recognizable name for the payment method (e.g., 'Business Check', 'Cash', 'Credit Card'). Maximum length is 31 characters."
    },
    "Type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "NON_CREDIT_CARD",
        "CREDIT_CARD"
      ],
      "description": "Type of payment method. Valid values: 'CREDIT_CARD', 'NON_CREDIT_CARD'. If not specified, defaults to 'NON_CREDIT_CARD'."
    },
    "Active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether the payment method is active. Default is true."
    },
    "SyncToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sync Token",
      "examples": [
        "0",
        "1"
      ],
      "description": "Version number for optimistic locking. Must match the current version in QuickBooks to prevent conflicts. Required for updates."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to update an existing payment method in QuickBooks Online."
}
```

**Output schema:**

## QUICKBOOKS_UPDATE_SPARSE_INVOICE
Tool to perform a sparse update of an existing invoice. Use when you need to update only specific invoice fields without overwriting other data.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSparseInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "required": [
        "Id",
        "SyncToken"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "Id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "Unique identifier of the Invoice to update"
        },
        "sparse": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Sparse",
          "default": true,
          "description": "Flag to indicate a sparse (partial) update; must be true"
        },
        "SyncToken": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Sync Token",
          "description": "Concurrency token; must match the latest from QuickBooks"
        }
      },
      "description": "Invoice object containing Id, SyncToken, sparse flag, and fields to update",
      "additionalProperties": true
    }
  },
  "description": "Request for performing a sparse (partial) update on an existing Invoice."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_UPDATE_TERM
Tool to update an existing payment term in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to modify the name, status, type, or payment conditions of a payment term. Requires the payment term Id and current SyncToken.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTermRequest",
  "required": [
    "Id",
    "SyncToken",
    "Name",
    "Type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "Id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "1",
        "8"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the payment term to update. Required for updates."
    },
    "Name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Net 30",
        "Due on receipt - Updated",
        "Net 15"
      ],
      "maxLength": 31,
      "description": "User-recognizable name for the payment term (e.g., 'Net 30', 'Due on receipt'). Maximum length 31 characters."
    },
    "Type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "STANDARD",
        "DATEDRIVEN"
      ],
      "description": "Type of the sales term. Valid values: 'STANDARD' (if dueDays is not null) or 'DATEDRIVEN' (if dueDays is null)."
    },
    "Active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether the payment term is active. Default is true."
    },
    "DueDays": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Due Days",
      "examples": [
        0,
        15,
        30,
        60,
        120
      ],
      "description": "Number of days until payment is due. If specified, Type should be 'STANDARD'. Use 0 for 'Due on receipt'."
    },
    "SyncToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sync Token",
      "examples": [
        "0",
        "1"
      ],
      "description": "Version number for optimistic locking. Must match the current version in QuickBooks to prevent conflicts. Required for updates."
    },
    "DiscountDays": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Discount Days",
      "examples": [
        0,
        10,
        15
      ],
      "description": "Number of days within which payment must be made to receive the discount. Used with discount_percent for early payment discounts."
    },
    "DayOfMonthDue": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Day Of Month Due",
      "maximum": 31,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Specific day of the month when payment is due. Used for DATEDRIVEN type terms. Valid range: 1-31."
    },
    "DiscountPercent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Discount Percent",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 0,
      "examples": [
        0,
        2,
        5,
        10
      ],
      "description": "Discount percentage available if paid within the discount days. Valid range: 0 to 100."
    },
    "DueNextMonthDays": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Due Next Month Days",
      "description": "Number of days in the month before the due date shifts to the next month. Used for DATEDRIVEN type terms."
    },
    "DiscountDayOfMonth": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Discount Day Of Month",
      "maximum": 31,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Specific day of the month when discount is available. Used for DATEDRIVEN type terms. Valid range: 1-31."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to update an existing payment term in QuickBooks Online."
}
```

## QUICKBOOKS_UPDATE_TRANSFER
Tool to update an existing transfer in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to modify a transfer between accounts. Requires the transfer Id and current SyncToken to prevent concurrent update conflicts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTransferRequest",
  "required": [
    "Id",
    "SyncToken",
    "Amount",
    "FromAccountRef",
    "ToAccountRef"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "Id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the transfer to update. Required for update operations."
    },
    "Amount": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Amount",
      "description": "The monetary amount to transfer between accounts. Specified as a string (e.g., '35.00')."
    },
    "TxnDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Txn Date",
      "description": "The date of the transfer transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to current date if not specified."
    },
    "SyncToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sync Token",
      "description": "Version token for optimistic locking, obtained from a prior GET request. Prevents concurrent update conflicts."
    },
    "CurrencyRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CurrencyRef",
      "required": [
        "value"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The name of the currency (e.g., 'United States Dollar')."
        },
        "value": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Value",
          "description": "The currency code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'CAD')."
        }
      },
      "description": "Reference to a currency for multi-currency transactions.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "PrivateNote": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Private Note",
      "description": "Internal note about the transfer that is not visible to customers."
    },
    "ExchangeRate": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Exchange Rate",
      "description": "Exchange rate for multi-currency transactions. Default is 1 for home currency. Only applicable when using non-home currency."
    },
    "ToAccountRef": {
```

## QUICKBOOKS_VENDOR_BALANCE_REPORT
Retrieve a vendor balance report from QuickBooks showing outstanding balances for vendors. This report displays the total amount owed to each vendor, providing a summary of accounts payable. You can filter by specific vendors, date ranges, payment status, and customize the report with various grouping and sorting options.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "VendorBalanceReportRequest",
  "properties": {
    "qzurl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Qzurl",
      "description": "Specifies whether Quick Zoom URL information should be generated for rows in the report."
    },
    "appaid": {
      "enum": [
        "All",
        "Paid",
        "Unpaid"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Arpaid",
      "description": "Filters vendors by payment status. Use 'All' for all vendors, 'Paid' for vendors with fully paid balances, or 'Unpaid' for vendors with outstanding balances."
    },
    "date_macro": {
      "enum": [
        "Today",
        "Yesterday",
        "This Week",
        "Last Week",
        "This Week-to-date",
        "Last Week-to-date",
        "Next Week",
        "Next 4 Weeks",
        "This Month",
        "Last Month",
        "This Month-to-date",
        "Last Month-to-date",
        "Next Month",
        "This Fiscal Quarter",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Quarter-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Quarter",
        "This Fiscal Year",
        "Last Fiscal Year",
        "This Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Last Fiscal Year-to-date",
        "Next Fiscal Year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DateMacro",
      "description": "Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascend",
        "descend"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SortOrder",
      "description": "The sort order."
    },
    "vendor_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Vendor Ids",
      "description": "Filters report contents to include information for specified vendors. Supported Values: One or more comma separated vendor IDs as returned in the attribute, Vendor.Id, of the Vendor object response code."
    },
    "report_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Date",
      "description": "Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "department_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Department Ids",
      "description": "One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. "
    },
    "accounting_method": {
      "enum": [
        "Cash",
        "Accrual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccountingMethod",
      "description": "The accounting method used in the report. "
    },
    "summarize_column_by": {
      "enum": [
        "Total",
        "Month",
        "Week",
        "Days",
        "Quarter",
        "Year",
        "Customers",
        "Vendors",
        "Classes",
        "Departments",
        "Employees",
        "ProductsAndServices"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SummarizeColumnBy",
      "description": "The criteria by which to group the report results."
    }
  }
}
```
